page_title: BOC 0-1 HOF | Bochum v Hoffenheim 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Florian Badstubner is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
90+5' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Rough tackle by Bernardo (Bochum). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' It looks like Bernardo (Bochum) saw red with that tackle. Florian Badstubner won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' A substitution has been made. Andrej Kramaric goes off and Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) comes on.
87' Substitution. Mats Pannewig (Bochum) replaces Ibrahima Sissoko.
87' Dieter Hecking has decided to make a change. Samuel Bamba (Bochum) replaces Maximilian Wittek.
86' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
85' There's an opportunity for Matus Bero (Bochum) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) for Gift Orban.

84' Dani de Wit (Bochum) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
84' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dani de Wit (Bochum) is coming onto the pitch as Tom Krauss cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Hoffenheim.
75' Dieter Hecking has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) replacing Georgios Masouras.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felix Passlack trots off the pitch and is replaced by Koji Miyoshi (Bochum).

72' 0 - 1 Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way low into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.
71' The attendance for today's match is 24120.
70' Florian Badstubner has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tom Krauss (Bochum).
67' PENALTY APPEAL after Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
65' Total attempts – 8:6.
61' What a long-range shot by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
59' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Arthur Chaves and he is replaced by Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim).
59' Max Moerstedt will be replaced by Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim).
58' Matus Bero (Bochum) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
58' Florian Badstubner interrupts the game. One of the players from Hoffenheim won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

56' Tom Krauss (Bochum) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Oliver Baumann pulls off an easy save.
55' The foul by Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) was seen by Florian Badstubner who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
55' Matus Bero (Bochum) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
55' Matus Bero (Bochum) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Bochum force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
53' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
52' Bochum control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
49' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) is adjudged offside.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Good clearance! Matus Bero (Bochum) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.

40' The cross fools the defence and leaves Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
39' A player from Hoffenheim commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
38' The game is interrupted. Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
37' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

37' A neat pass finds Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the right side of the goal, but Timo Horn denies him with a good save.

36' Tim Oermann (Bochum) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Florian Badstubner with no other option than to blow for a foul.
35' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
34' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Bochum enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike. The percentage of ball possession is – 56:44.
31' A dangerous looking corner kick from Matus Bero (Bochum) is cleared to safety by the defence.

30' Bochum couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) leaped high and intercepted the cross. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' The referee blows his whistle as Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick to Bochum.
28' Leo Ostigard (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Florian Badstubner stops the game and makes a call.
27' Matus Bero (Bochum) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

27' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out for a corner. Bochum can continue in their attacking effort.
26' The resulting corner from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is cleared by the defence.
24' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Hoffenheim concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
20' Florian Badstubner couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) and blew his whistle.
17' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
13' The corner by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
10' Jakov Medic (Bochum) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
10' A player from Bochum commits a rough challenge. Florian Badstubner blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
9' Florian Badstubner blows for a foul after Felix Passlack (Bochum) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' The Bochum players are exchanging some short passes.
5' Tom Krauss (Bochum) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
4' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florian Badstubner no option but to blow his whistle.
3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum).
3' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) was too forceful with his tackle and Florian Badstubner interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
